reviewTitle: Awkward design, creates lumpy look and bulges
reviewDescription: I sized way up for starters, got a 4XL when I'm usually an XL or sometimes 2XL depending. Still fit pretty snug, but would be wearable IF it were not for some terrible pit falls to this design. This is definitely a full on thong, it leaves the cheeks fully exposed, which causes a big problem with the front design. The front crotch area doesn't come up high waisted, it tries to stay lower in the front like briefs would, I suppose to cover more. BUT, because the back obviously comes up higher, it causes the front to be tugged and roll up, leaving all the love handle/hip area uncovered and bulging out MOST horribly. Very uncomfortable and unsightly- those are some of the areas I was trying to smooth over. The effect is like some kind of muffin top that has melted down around your hips. I find it to be unwearable.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on January 29, 2025
